# Pragmatism Is a Method and a Genetic Theory of Truth[^1]

Mr. Schiller still gives to all this view of truth the name of 'Humanism,' but, for this doctrine too, the name of pragmatism seems fairly to be in the ascendant. Such then would be the scope of pragmatism--first, a method; and second, a genetic theory of what is meant by truth.

[^1]: [[@Pragmatism - William James]]
